label: No predicate both holds and fails of the same being in the same respect
paraphrase: Non-contradiction for the case predicates: for every predicate of beings in respects, nothing both has it and lacks it in the same respect (Aristotle, Metaphysics IV.3, 1005b19-20).

self_evident.note: Floor item F1 (#1007), approved by the owner on the retorsion basis. Aristotle defends the principle elenctically, from what an opponent grants by speaking significantly (Metaphysics IV.4, 1006a11-28; claim ARIST-MET-1006A-PNC-ELENCTIC-A). Lean refutes the denial without axioms (LOGIC-CASE-NON-CONTRADICTION-NOT-DENIABLE), so inside the encoded logic the principle is no assumption. The marking records the floor relativity of D-L: a dialetheist (Hegel on motion, Priest) rejects that Lean's negation represents their position, so a classical refutation of a dialetheic rival counts only relative to this marking.
